1. Bid Documents - can be obtained from CJ or BAC.
2. Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) - signed by Mayor and RD, witnessed by LGU staff and EMB Division Chief and notarized.
3. Deed of Donation (DOD) - signed by Mayor and RD, witnessed by LGU staff and EMB Division Chief and notarized.
4. Delivery Receipt and Delivery Checklist - signed by the receiving LGU's accountant, property custodian/GSO or mayor.
5. Technical Inspection Checklist - signed by inspector, (supplier if possible) and receiving LGU.
6. Completion Checklist - prepared by project focal, signed by section chief and approved by division chief.
7. Property Transfer Report (PTR) - receiving LGU's accountant, property custodian/GSO or mayor. Please ask from jessie
8. Journal Entry Voucher (JEV) - returned by the receiving LGU to EMB to document that the equipment has already been transferred to their books
